Subject: 48hr concierge credit request for BrightBridge upsell

Heads up — BrightBridge (Aisha Patel) is at the end of their 14-day pilot and digging into production rollout questions. Usage spiked this week (attached usage report) and they told me privately they need a little runway to finish an internal security review and get procurement over the line.

Why this matters: this is a likely $180k ARR account if they convert; they are evaluating Dedicated later this year. We have a chance to convert now if we offer a short, targeted credit to remove risk.

Ask: can I offer a timed concierge credit of $8,000 (applied to hosted usage) that would extend their trial + cover estimated usage through the review window? Conditions I suggest: 1) they sign a 6-month paid commitment at the end of the trial (or convert to paid within 30 days), 2) credit expires if not used within 45 days, and 3) we note the concession on deal DB-4782 in HubSpot.

Attachments: BrightBridge_MVP_usage_report.pdf, proposed_terms (concierge_credit_terms.txt).

If you want a different number I'm flexible — this is time-sensitive (Aisha wants to finalize by Tue). Can you both weigh in before EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Sean

Thanks Sean — good context. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I sign off: 
- Is this strictly a usage credit (hosted tokens) or does it include support/concierge hours?
- What's the absolute max we can commit to without VP sign-off? Last quarter I think that threshold was $10k.
- Do we have any signal from Procurement on timeline? If they need contract redlines that may push the sign date.

If it's purely usage credit and conditional on a 6-month commit, I can greenlight up to $8k from my side. If it includes additional services I'd want Marissa or revenue ops to OK.

Sean / Ben — I'm OK to approve but with firm guardrails. Approved: up to $10,000 in hosted usage credit, subject to these conditions: 
1) Customer signs a 6-month paid commitment (minimum committed spend $15k) or a binding PO for the conversion before the credit is issued.
2) Credit applied only to hosted API usage; does not cover Dedicated setup or professional services.
3) Credit must be consumed within 45 days of issuance. Any unused credit lapses.
4) Sales documents must capture the concession and reason in HubSpot (DB-4782) and Legal must pre-clear the short T&Cs (I attached the text file).

Ben — your $8k lower threshold is acceptable; I'll approve escalation to $10k if you confirm the 6-month commitment condition is enforceable. I'll loop Legal if we need to adapt the T&Cs.

Sean — proceed to put a formal offer in writing to Aisha and include Procurement. Send me the HubSpot note and I'll sign off on the final DocuSign if it matches these terms.

Marissa Cole
